title: Persistent Lines of Neutral Sodium (Na I)
publisher: NIST Physical Measurement Laboratory, Handbook of Basic Atomic Spectroscopic Data (SRD 108)
scope: These two tabulated wavelengths are reference data, not a captured lamp image or a measured detector trace. No uncertainty is invented. NIST notes that newer, higher-accuracy Na I sources exist. The two simulated line responses receive equal normalized weights; tabulated relative intensities are not treated as universal source powers.

modelSources.use: In-plane grating geometry; normal incidence reduces to m lambda = d sin theta.
R = |m| N, equal-line Rayleigh criterion, and distinction between grating resolving power and whole-instrument spectral resolution.
